coverage_assessment: Documented open-web first pass: 14 captured searches, 317 raw headers, four weekly windows, one Dzongkha-script and two Nepali queries, eight named regions, worker/education/farm/transport/health sectors, and January–March boundary checks. Five source bodies were read with recorded scopes; one e-paper URL returned actual HTTP 403 after stable access review and one monthly archive showed a verification loader. No qualifying event is established from this coverage; this is not proof of absence. Coordinator review and official baseline remain pending.
timestamp_note: Actual worker start recorded from the system UTC clock; query and retrieval times will use actual tool metadata where exposed.
